notes: This bounded contract covers the embedded development-profile implementation of the official HLAmanager.HLAfederate.HLAadjust.HLAmodifyAttributeState MOM interaction. The sender-side adapter decodes the inherited HLAfederate target plus HLAobjectInstance, HLAattribute, and HLAattributeState; the registry applies a synchronous, callback-free ownership transition through the existing application ownership ledger. Owned requires that the target knows the object and publishes the corresponding attribute at its known class; Unowned clears the application owner; predefined joined-federate MOM attributes are rejected as RTI-owned and never enter that ledger. The Catch2 case proves owner-to-target assignment, unowned state, target-publication rejection, immediate re-assignment, no acquisition/release callbacks, and the RTI-owned MOM boundary. The Requirements Lab has no row-level candidate for the Table 18/20 HLAmodifyAttributeState semantics, so this contract selects only the closest exported MOM receive/leaf-class and ownership candidates and records the remaining source-derived details here rather than inventing candidate IDs. It does not claim complete MOM exception-report delivery, malformed/missing parameter coverage, all membership/error branches, pending ownership-arbitration interaction, resign disposition, timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM, remote transport, package/JUnit/protected review, or conformance.
